summary: 66-year-old male hiker slipped and fell injuring his ankle on the trail between the First and Second Flatiron at Chautauqua Open Space, unable to walk out; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and City of Boulder Open Space Mountain Parks rangers located him, provided medical care, packaged him in a beanbag splint and litter, and conducted a technical evacuation to the trailhead; AMR transported him by ambulance to a hospital (BCSO case 21-6185)
location: Between First and Second Flatiron, Chautauqua Open Space
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder County Sheriff's Office, City of Boulder Open Space Mountain Parks, American Medical Response
